name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Heartless Symphony
summary: Vampire: The Masquerade – Heartless Symphony is an upcoming narrative RPG set in the World of Darkness, developed by Entalto Studios. Expanding on the events of Vampire: The Masquerade – Heartless Lullaby, the game follows multiple characters through a dark urban story shaped by player choices rather than dice rolls. Featuring character customization, skill progression, and branching narratives with multiple endings, the game is expected to offer a 10–15 hour experience with side quests and several playable perspectives. With a hand-drawn art style inspired by Disco Elysium, Heartless Symphony aims to provide an accessible entry point to the World of Darkness for both newcomers and longtime fans.
